verdict.rationale: Obsidian's core design stores notes as plain-text Markdown files locally in a user-owned vault, explicitly marketed for offline use and future-proofing/app independence, corroborated by independent community reports of migrating away from cloud apps because files are local text that outlive the app. Minor caveat is Canvas's JSON format (still local, but less human-readable than Markdown), and mobile has a save-timing quirk under sync; missing for 10: independent long-term audit of full offline reliability across all core plugins and confirmation Canvas/Bases data remain equally portable as plain Markdown.
